replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Going to be brutally honest here, the map looks rushed. The block palette isn't the best.. not much thought went into the terrain either. Map is quite small and conjested. 

What I would suggest;
Expand all squadrants to an extent where you could easily fit 15 players in it, without it being chaotic :P
Use the smooth tool in WorldEdit to refine the ridged hill edges. This will make the terrain flow - if you will.
Don't always use the world edit commands for the block palette! By combining and randomizing selected blocks is repeative, and can sometimes be boring. Change it up :)

Add structures like huts. Doing this will provide more chest placements, and aesthetic improvements! 

You guys have the right idea and the potential is there, but keep on improving to get it just right!

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Way too confusing with the 16 different blocks in the landscape. It'll be hard to dig because of the low amount of wood, and the fact to dig you have to break clay. There needs to be animals and food avaliable for players, and there absolutely needs to be more structures included. The landscape itself seems very WorldEdited and doesn't have a natural feel to it, making it looked rushed and not to terms of what a walls map should be. The map also is rotated wrong...

I'm sorry for all the negatives, but I don't see this being a too great of a walls map for people to actively play on

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
My suggestion is to rethink the theme of the map, and start over. After looking at the map, I see no real way to make it where the map is going to end up in rotations without a major overhaul, to the extent that it does not look like the same map.

Take it from me : I know what it is like to work hard and produce a map, and that map not make it. This is just one of those times where you start over - in my opinion. 

Thank you for making a walls map, sorry I didn't see this post sooner
